note: The 'contractor must never download' restriction is written as an EFFECT_DENY scoped to roles:["contractor"]. Because a person can also hold the employee role, whose rule allows download, the deny is defeated across roles (allow wins across roles) and the dual-role principal is granted download — a genuine multi-role deny-override hole. Verified with the compiler: a ["contractor","employee"] principal resolves to EFFECT_ALLOW for download.
